Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Malic acid is used as a flavour enhancer in food. Its technological role is to strengthen flavours already present in food.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include peeled cut and shredded fruit and vegetables, canned or bottled fruit and vegetables, jam jellies and marmalades and similar products, other similar fruit or vegetable spreads. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
